info.title: Todoer rebuild REST and authorization API
info.description: Implemented rebuild interfaces. Production configuration supports verified Google browser identity, live sessions, and scoped credentials. Development mode remains an explicit synthetic loopback adapter. Local OAuth SDK interoperability does not establish universal connector compatibility or production deployment readiness.

post.description: Runs common domain mutations and rolls them back; actor-bound review expires in 600 seconds. Max 50 operations, 500 reviewed task states and 1 MiB stored plan. Tags must already exist; no create/completion operations.

Executes only server-stored reviewed operations. All steps, current permissions and metadata are rechecked atomically. Exact actor/key/hash retries return the stored result only after live access checks.

post.description: Authorized literal Unicode token-prefix search; no fuzzy or semantic matching. Default open status. Cursor binds actor, query, live access and index generation; conflict message resync_required requires restart. Date filters use stored local calendar dates. Unknown historic core timestamps remain absent.

get.description: Scalar filters or exclusive query=JSON. Use POST or query JSON for arrays/projection.

schema.description: URL-encoded StructuredQuery JSON; exclusive with scalar fields

post.description: Compact common-domain adapter. Read actions require read; mutations require write and browser CSRF when using sessions. Revisions belong to tasks except tag_rename uses tag revision and reorder uses list revision.

Compact reference operations. Resolve returns zero/one/multiple accessible choices without selecting an ambiguous target. Bind validates source revision and occurrence, consumes a currently accessible exact candidate, and bumps source revision.

get.description: Workspace members see scoped registry; direct list guests see only tags used in this accessible list.

post.description: Creates or reuses normalized name in list home. Standalone workspace-tag creation requires workspace editor access; direct guests can introduce names through task assignment.

put.description: Replaces complete tag set, using IDs in the task home or names; creates missing names atomically with assignment. Task revision CAS.
Only roots can be assigned directly; descendants inherit. Null clears. Task revision CAS.

post.description: Same-list only; null makes a root. Cycles rejected; subtree section follows parent, and unfinished descendants reopen completed ancestors.
List revision CAS; IDs must contain every active sibling exactly once. Null parent selects roots.

Common scheduling operations. Set replaces the schedule and uses task revision; series_state uses series revision. Planning and series_list return at most100 compact records with truncated flag. Dates are explicit; no personal preferences are exposed to scoped clients. Review uses explicit from/to plus optional list_id/workspace_id, preserves counting notes and coverage, and omits upcoming task descriptions (empty strings).

Common comment and attachment operations. Comments default to300-character excerpts, pages1..50; include_bodies caps page size to10. Files lists cap100. No binary content or object keys. Upload size/SHA256 verified at finalization; link metadata requires browser or separate REST-audience credential for download.

Common organization/sharing/invitation operations. Workspace members list capped100 with truncated flag. Grants and expanded audiences need explicit acknowledgement and live admin authority. Invite requires idempotency key and may queue email; it does not claim/accept an invitation. list_move_preview/list_move require live owners in both workspaces and exact reviewed list/source/destination revisions and policy_hash; visibility expansion must be acknowledged.
